title: The truth about AI replacing radiologists

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know AI is already reading scans faster than humans?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Radiologists are facing a seismic shift in their daily work.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI tools like Google's DeepMind can detect tumors with 94% accuracy.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: They're not replacing radiologists — they're augmenting their power.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Doctors now get second opinions in seconds, not hours.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key is collaboration, not competition.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What do you think — will AI make doctors better or obsolete?

caption_text: The truth about AI replacing radiologists
